text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application for a 26-storey mixed use building, plus mechanical penthouse. The building height to the top of the mechanical penthouse measures 85 metres. The building would contain 391 dwelling units and 240 parking spaces. A total of 3,199 square metres of non-residential space for commercial uses is proposed. The proposed Floor Space Index ("FSI") is 5.86. The application has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. City Planning staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application, in consultation with the Ward Councillor.
City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, received Item NY34.10 for information.
